svg.title: Thanks for playing
svg.desc: Footer: THANKS FOR PLAYING. The red-hooded hero rests at a campfire save point under a pixel moon while fireflies drift. A bubble reads SAVE POINT REACHED and a game-over prompt asks CONTINUE? with a blinking selector on YES. Trying one of my tools? I'd love to hear what works.
svg.text: TRYING ONE OF MY TOOLS? I'D LOVE TO HEAR WHAT WORKS.
